@june.osei-lark: On 1 Jul, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with Vantorre's support team. He said it was fixed when Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets. The standard Detention Summary template then worked for their billing team, so they didn't need the custom CSV export.

The GBrain notes also mention #8841 on other dates, describing different problems (a kiosk timeout at Allentown in May, and a Door 14 kiosk issue at Newark in September). I can't tell from here whether the number was reused or the notes are wrong, so check the ticket record before quoting it in the QBR.
